newsitems.title: Team Fortress 2 исполнилось 19 лет - культовый шутер Valve приближается к юбилею
newsitems.contents:
10 октября 2007 года состоялся релиз Team Fortress 2 — многопользовательского шутера от Valve, который за почти два десятилетия стал одной из самых узнаваемых игр в жанре. Сегодня, 10 октября 2026 года, проект отмечает 19-летие, а до круглого юбилея остаётся всего год.

Team Fortress 2 выделяется своим мультяшным визуальным стилем, узнаваемыми персонажами и юмором. В основе игры — командные сражения между двумя противоборствующими сторонами, где успех зависит от взаимодействия игроков и грамотного выбора класса. Всего в игре девять классов, каждый со своим оружием, способностями и ролью на поле боя: от тяжеловооружённого Пулемётчика до быстрого Разведчика и инженера, который строит турели и точки снабжения.

Изначально Team Fortress 2 вышла в составе сборника The Orange Box вместе с Half-Life 2: Episode Two и Portal. Позже игра стала доступна отдельно и перешла на условно-бесплатную модель распространения. Благодаря необычному художественному стилю, мемам, коллекционированию предметов и активному сообществу она надолго пережила многие другие сетевые шутеры своего времени.

За годы существования Team Fortress 2 обзавелась огромным количеством пользовательских материалов, карт, режимов и внутриигровых предметов. Несмотря на возраст, игра продолжает привлекать поклонников.

Теперь сообществу осталось дождаться следующей важной даты — 20-летия Team Fortress 2, которое наступит 10 октября 2027 года.

newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/335762ec7cc40c8f1041504bc6a614edc6ad50d6.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Breaking News: Modern Warfare 4: DMZ Early Access Confirmed![/h2][p]This is Warfare Without Limits. Experience the gripping story of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], as well as DMZ, Call of Duty’s action extraction shooter, before the October 23 launch. Campaign and DMZ Early Access are confirmed. Here’s the intel:[/p][p][/p][h3]How Do I Access the Modern Warfare 4 Campaign and DMZ Early?[/h3][p]Starting on Friday, October 16, players who have digitally pre-ordered or pre-purchased [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/i] get Early Access to the game’s Campaign.[/p][p]Then, starting on Tuesday October 20, players who have digitally pre-ordered or pre-purchased [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/i] can gain Early Access to all of DMZ.*[/p][p]This benefit applies to those pre-ordering or pre-purchasing the Standard Digital Edition or Vault Edition of the game on Steam. [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2026/05/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-preorder-benefits-game-editions-details#Vault"]See this blog for pre-order benefits[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="SV5vKAAkQkQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][i]*Campaign and DMZ Early Access start dates differ. Actual play time subject to possible outages and applicable time zone differences. Actual platform availability and start dates subject to change.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]WELCOME TO DMZ[/h2][p]This is Call of Duty’s [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/680752246528410471"]definitive extraction shooter experience[/url], featuring persistent progression and open-world combat environment. You’re free to explore, engage AI forces and rival Operators, loot valuable items, craft gear, and complete objectives— all while keeping your eye on the final exfil, extracting with your rewards at the end of each deployment. How you approach each deployment, within a squad or acting alone, is entirely up to you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fbb2b156cfa462836f7fdda8d2f28f9e511eefe5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You’re here to learn everything there is to know about [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]’s DMZ. The intel has been separated into two blogs.[/p][p][b]Part 1: Tour of Duty – Hajin Environments and Threats, Full Intel Guide[/b] [/p][p]Think you’re ready to deploy into war-torn Hajin? Consult the Tour of Duty – Hajin blog for a full rundown of its points of interest, key buildings, vehicles, enemy threats, and trackable statistics. Click here to read this blog.[/p][p][b]Part 2: Tour of Duty – Forward Operating Base (FOB) Full Intel Guide[/b][/p][p]A tour of the FOB stations, with information on 3D Printer crafting, Bounties, Weapon acquisition, Stashes and Loadouts, Active Duty Operators, DMZ Operator Prestiging, Permanent Prestige Traits, and DMZ Player Progression to Level 70. You’re reading this now![/p][p]Welcome to the Forward Operating Base.[/p][p][/p][h3]Forward Operating Base (FOB): Overview[/h3][p][i]Available Immediately / Accessed from the DMZ Main Menu[/i] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1c554cf376a4e7e6281ad6415c55e5ef6e858acd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Forward Operating Base (FOB) is your home between DMZ deployments. This navigable encampment allows you to offload your loot, gear up, receive your next Orders, before you head back into Hajin. The FOB is also home to DMZ’s permanent progression, including customizing your Active Duty Operators.[/p][p]As you conduct further deployments into the Exclusion Zone, the FOB unlocks and upgrades into a fully established base.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0204878e6d8824256b446cc2aa417bbb7795483b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Throughout the FOB, there are various stations, and they can be critical to your survival when deployed in the Exclusion Zone. Some stations are unlocked through playing DMZ and can then be upgraded using the 3D Printer station. These stations allow you to track down dangerous Lieutenants, build out your perfect weapon, swap out your Active Duty Operator, craft powerful gear, and more. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4b72782d83a01c3daded6d266ca46cad8e99e5fe.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Here are the Stations that your FOB is comprised of, starting with those you should access first:[/p][list][*][p][b]Operators (Active Duty):[/b] Manage your available Operators, check their status, upgrade their Traits, and select one ready for deployment.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]DMZ Orders:[/b] DMZ Orders are your guiding Mission Directives in DMZ. These assist with getting you onboarded, telling the story of DMZ and challenging you to master the exclusion zone.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Stash/Loadout:[/b] The Stash allows you to store a variety of loot types from Weapons to Gear to 3D Printer Ingredients and more! Every time you extract, make sure to offload items you'll need in future deployments. Equip weapons and gear in your Loadout, ready for the next infil.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Firing Range:[/b] Test your weapons (especially your optics) and sharpen your aim in this wooded grove, with targets positioned from close to more than 100 meters away.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Survival Kits:[/b] These are themed packs of loot items that can be opened and then used to gear up or used to craft.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Bounty Leaderboard:[/b] Track the most successful PvP bounty hunters and killers across the Exclusion Zone.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a4c0db9193266db39dfaa400898050446c6a5c9f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Continue your successful deployments across Hajin, and you’re soon able to expand your FOB, and unlock additional stations:[/p][list][*][p][b]3D Printer (Unlocks at DMZ Player Level 2):[/b] This uses a mix of Printer Resources and 3D Printer Ingredients to craft a variety of gear. The 3D Printer is also used to upgrade various stations in the FOB provided you have the required loot items.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Boss Board (Unlocks after you complete your second DMZ Order):[/b] Purchase intel on Lieutenants, then locate and prepare to hunt down Hajin’s most powerful adversaries. Additional information is also available for Commanders.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Vendor (Unlocks at DMZ Player Level 5):[/b] The Vendor has a variety of weapons and other items for sale using DMZ Cash. The vendor’s wares rotate day to day so get this gear while it’s available! [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Gunsmith (Unlocks at DMZ Player Level 10):[/b] Use in-game DMZ Cash to purchase attachments for looted weapons and to build brand new weapons from scratch. The attachments you can build are related to the level of the weapon and the shared attachments unlocked for that weapon. To increase the weapons you can build in Gunsmith you need to find and extract Weapon Manuals.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Dog Tag Case (Unlocks at DMZ Player Level 20):[/b] Display Dog Tags collected from defeated Operators and favorite the ones you don’t want to lose.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The last stations are immediately available, and detail your full DMZ Player Progression, as well as confirming your deployment into Hajin:[/p][list][*][p][b]DMZ Progression:[/b] DMZ has its own dedicated Progression Track which awards key Printer Recipes, Unlocks FOB stations, and awards various other content all the way up to level 70![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Deploy:[/b] A threshold of razor wire leading to a heavy-lift military transport helicopter where you’ll begin each DMZ deployment.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Operators Station: Active Duty[/h3][p][i]Available Immediately / Accessed within the FOB, or the left side blade menu.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c45dae9eac1f28399714527d3cf5dbe372c97adb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The [b]Operators Station[/b] is where you can view, manage, and [b]select your Active Duty Operators[/b]. In DMZ, Operators are generally a cosmetic preference, individual characters who grow stronger as you survive deployments and award them Traits. You earn [b]DMZ Player Level XP[/b] with them.[/p][p]Each Operator comes with a set of Dog Tags. As an Active Duty Operator progresses, the quality of these Dog Tags improves, and Trait Points are awarded. Trait Points can be spent across three Trait Trees, allowing you to specialize in different playstyles. Ultimately, your Active Duty Operator can earn permanent Prestige Traits that are tied to each individual Operator.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a02d84bc0928aae17d5becca963a8d8b253d2720.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Recruiting an Operator[/h3][p]Firstly, recruit an Operator to an open slot. The Operator you pick for a slot is locked to that slot until they are dismissed by you in favor of a replacement. [/p][list][*][p]Example: If you select Reece as an Operator, you cannot change to another Operator. You also cannot choose Reece again in another Active Duty slot.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Operator Skins: You can change Reece’s Operator Skin in this menu.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]You begin with two available Active Duty Operator slots and can unlock another slot by progressing your DMZ level.[/p][/*][/list][p]Players with the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Vault Edition have access to an additional Active Duty slot and start with three instead of two.[/p][p][/p][h3]Understanding the Active Duty Basics[/h3][p]Keep these Active Duty basics in mind:[/p][list][*][p][b]Manage multiple Operators:[/b] Maintain multiple Active Duty Operators, giving you different builds to choose from.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Earn Trait Points:[/b] Successfully earn DMZ XP with an Operator to upgrade their Dog Tags, receiving a Trait Point each time you level up your Dog Tags. Traits are used to improve that specific Operator in various ways.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Choose your Traits:[/b] Spend Trait Points across three different playstyle Trait Trees; Warfighter, Scout, and Survivalist.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Create specialized Operators:[/b] A single Operator can earn up to 18 Trait Points.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Use your Active Duty slots and Trait selections to build Operators around different playstyles.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4d27b0dc96a97b0996492108731dad62be6d7abc.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]MIA Operators[/h3][p]If an Operator is eliminated during a deployment, they become MIA (Missing in Action) and cannot deploy again until they are recovered.[/p][list][*][p][b]Recover an MIA Operator:[/b] Spend DMZ Cash to bring an MIA Operator back while preserving all of their Traits. Access the Operators station and pay DMZ Cash from your in-game Bank to rescue them.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Progression and Cost:[/b] The cost to recover an Operator is determined by their Trait Points. The more Traits, the more expensive their return.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Reequip:[/b] Recovered Operators return without their gear, so equip a new Loadout before deploying again.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Dismiss and start over:[/b] Instead of recovery, you can dismiss an MIA Operator and start fresh with a new Operator.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Operator Dog Tag[/h3][p]Each Operator has a Dog Tag available to inspect in your Loadout, that represents the progression of the Operator wearing it. It can be removed if the Operator dies during a deployment and is recovered if an MIA Operator is brought back to Active Duty. The higher the quality (or Level) of the Dog Tag, the higher the progression of the Operator. This Dog Tag also shows the Bounty status of the Operator, and the enemy Operator kill count.[/p][p]As you progress and earn XP within DMZ, your Dog Tag’s Level progresses, allowing you to unlock Traits:[/p][p][b]Progression (18 Levels):[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Steel (I, II, III)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Bronze (I, II, III)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Silver (I, II, III)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Gold (I, II, III)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Damascus (I, II, III)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Onyx (I, II, III)[/p][/*][/list][p]The Level of your Dog Tag is worth noting, as rival Operators can defeat you in combat, and loot your belongings, including your Dog Tag, to display in their Dog Tag Case (see later in this Blog).[/p][p]Earn XP to increase your Dog Tag Level, receiving a Trait Point every time you reach a new Dog Tag Level. This is the key to accessing Traits.[/p][p]An Operator’s level (indicated by their Dog Tag quality) and a player’s overall DMZ level are independent. An Operator is considered fully leveled up when the Onyx III is reached, and 18 Trait Points have been earned. At this point, you can Prestige the Operator (see below).[/p][p][/p][h3]The Three Trait Trees[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/16ad32f27557bc32ade50e4a7c7a140014d61511.jpg"][/img][/p][p]These are accessed from the quick navigation left-blade menu for your currently equipped Operator and is also accessible via the Operator menu. Any Trait Tree Points you earn after successfully earning a Dog Tag level up after an exfil as that Operator are accessible here. You can have multiple Operators active (as many as you have slots) with each individually earning Trait Points. Spend Trait Points to acquire Traits from one of three Trees:[/p][list][*][p]Warfighter[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Scout[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Survivalist[/p][/*][/list][p]There are 66 Traits available in DMZ, spread equally across the three Trees. Not all of them can be accessed by your Operator, as you can only have a maximum of 18 Trait Points before you fully level up your Operator and reach Onyx III Dog Tag status. Here’s how this works:[/p][list][*][p]Every successful exfil awards you DMZ XP, and the level of your Dog Tag is affected by this. Acquire enough and you level up your Dog Tag, earning one Trait Point each time. If you’ve done particularly well during a deployment, you may level up your Dog Tag more than once.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]When you’ve acquired your first Trait Point, study the three Trait Trees closely. Each Tree has a total of 22 different Traits you can access.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Each Trait Tree consists of the following:[/p][/*][*][p]Seven Major Traits (always visible, arranged in groups of two aside from the initial Trait pick).[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]15 Minor Traits (randomized, only visible if you’ve unlocked the previous Main Trait below the Minor group and arranged in groups of three). [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Plan ahead to pick your preferred Main Trait, and then the available Minor Traits that complement your overall goals or playstyle along the way. Choose to unlock more Traits from an existing Trait Tree, or Traits from a different tree.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Spend your first Trait point on the initial Major Trait for that tree. The remaining Traits are in branches of two (Major) and three (Minor). [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Unlock one of the Traits from a previous branch to reach the next branch. Then choose a single Trait from that branch.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Continue until you’ve either completed unlocking a Tree (unlocking a maximum of nine Traits, one per branch) or unlocked a variety of branches from multiple Trees, as shown in the adjacent Trait menu screenshot.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Once you pick a Trait, it is locked in and can’t be substituted.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Therefore, with 18 Trait Points before you maximize your Operator level (and no more Trait Points are awarded), you can elect to max out two of the three Trait Trees or open all three to varying degrees of completion.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Remember: The more Traits you have, the more expensive your Operator is to rescue if they are downed during a deployment.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/20863df32fe99346cc6cc8892005973123ed3cc6.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Example Traits[/h3][p]There’s a great deal of variety of Traits to uncover as you progress your Operator, especially as these can (eventually) become permanently unlocked if you decide to Prestige in DMZ. Here are examples of the seven Main (visible) Traits for each of the three Trait Trees:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Main Warfighter Traits[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Adrenaline Burst:[/b] Killing an enemy resets tactical sprint.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Equipment Professional:[/b] Slowly recharges equipped Lethals and Tacticals after use.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Combat Resistance:[/b] Reduces damage from explosives and the effects of enemy Tacticals.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Viper Sense:[/b] Conceals you from thermal optics and AI targeting systems.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Quick Fix:[/b] Reduces health regeneration delay when an enemy operator or hostile is killed.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Possum:[/b] Allows a Self Revive into Last Stand from death, restoring health to maximum, once per match.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Adaptive Restock:[/b] Enemy hostile drop one additional item.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Main Scout Traits[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Investor:[/b] Slightly increases cash amount extracted.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Hostile Looter:[/b] Enemy hostiles sometimes drop an Uncommon printer ingredient, with a very small chance for a Rare printer ingredient.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Container Looter:[/b] Chance to get extra piece of loot in containers.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Thermal Padding:[/b] Hides from UAVs and downgrades Advanced UAVs to UAV detection.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]UAV Upgrade:[/b] Increases the range and duration of UAVs. Also upgrades them to Advanced UAVs.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Overwatch:[/b] UAV towers you activate never expire.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Field Crafting:[/b] Allows crafting items directly out of Common printer resources while deployed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Main Survivalist Traits[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Air Superiority:[/b] Extends the duration of UAV towers and SAM sites.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Faster Revive:[/b] Increases Revive speeds.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Consumable Duration:[/b] Increases the duration of consumables.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Impact Smokes[/b]: Releases smoke when downed.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Free Revive:[/b] Automatically repairs your first Wound.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Numb the Pain:[/b] Applies Painkillers and Smelling Salts effects on revives.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Die Hard:[/b] Approaching an exfil while in Last Stand calls the exfil automatically. Also grants infinite bleed out time while in Last Stand.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Operators Station: DMZ Operator Prestige[/h3][p][i]Available after an Active Duty Operator earns 18 Trait Points / Accessed at the Operators station or Traits side menu[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dd4b3ba3e1af8f428d0a2b0e8c43a7bc5aefa6a8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Once an Active Duty Operator earns 18 Trait Points, you can Prestige the Operator as long as they aren’t MIA and require rescuing. DMZ Operator Prestige is separate from the standard Level 1–55 Player Progression, the 1-70 DMZ Player Progression and other MW4 Prestige systems. It is tied to a specific Operator.[/p][p]DMZ Operator Prestige is optional, the requirements to Prestige can be a challenge, but the reward is worth it: With each Operator Prestige, [b]a special random Prestige Trait[/b] [b]is equipped permanently to that Operator[/b]. Operators can earn up to three Prestige Traits.[/p][p]Here are the requirements for your Operator to Prestige for the first time:[/p][list][*][p][b]Requirement 1:[/b] Maximum Operator Level: You must have earned a total of 18 Trait Points with the Operator. The Trait Points don’t need to be spent, though it is recommended you do so.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Requirement 2:[/b] Equip Gear of Specific Rarity: Acquire and equip high Rarity Loadout equipment to the Operator’s Loadout and Backpack. For the first Prestige, you need:[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Two Weapons (Rare Rarity or higher, each with three Attachment slots)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Plate Carrier (Rare Rarity or higher)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Backpack (Rare Rarity or higher)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Printer Ingredients (4 total, Rare Rarity or higher)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Remember to remove any items you don’t want to sacrifice from your Backpack or Loadout too; these are lost when you Prestige.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Requirement 3: Required Cash:[/b] You must have sufficient DMZ Cash funds, deducted from your in-game DMZ Cash Bank.[/p][/*][/list][p]Meet all three requirements, and once you place your Gear in your Loadout and select Prestige in DMZ, all the required Gear is removed, the payment of in-game Funds occurs, and your Operator’s Traits are removed and reset.[/p][p]Then, a random, [b]Permanent Prestige Trait[/b] is granted to your Operator.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/382c24895624689a75c5ec1669e8514ff2ac0b37.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Permanent Prestige Operator Traits[/b][/p][p]Here’s what you need to know about Permanent Prestige Traits:[/p][list][*][p]The Operator (and only that Active Duty Operator) gains the Prestige Trait.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]This is randomly selected from the available Trait pool.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Permanent Prestige Traits are just that: They remain tied to the Operator, even if you dismiss them, assign them to a different Active Duty slot, or change their Operator skin.[/p][/*][/list][p]At this point, you can continue developing your Operator, working towards a specialized soldier, supremely skilled in various acts of modern warfare.[/p][p][/p][p][b]DMZ Prestige: Levels 2 and 3[/b][/p][p]After Prestiging, you earn Trait Tree Points over again as before. If your Active Duty Operator reaches maximum level again (18 Trait Tree Points) you can Prestige for a second time.[/p][p] The requirements increase depending on the Operator Prestige level:[/p][list][*][p][b]DMZ First Prestige:[/b] [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Two Weapons with three Attachment Slots.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]One Plate Carrier (Rare Rarity)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]One Backpack (Rare Rarity)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Four 3D Printer Ingredients (Rare Rarity)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]200,000 DMZ Cash[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]DMZ Second Prestige:[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Two Weapons with four Attachment Slots.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]One Plate Carrier (Epic Rarity)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]One Backpack (Epic Rarity)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Four 3D Printer Ingredients (Epic Rarity)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]300,000 DMZ Cash[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]DMZ Third Prestige (and every Prestige thereafter):[/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Two Weapons with four Attachment Slots.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]One Plate Carrier (Legendary Rarity)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]One Backpack (Legendary Rarity)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Four 3D Printer Ingredients (Legendary Rarity)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]500,000 DMZ Cash[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Each time you Prestige, you receive an additional, random Permanent Prestige Trait.[/p][/*][/list][p]Your Operator can have a maximum of three Permanent Prestige Traits.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Beyond Prestige Level 3[/b][/p][p]Once you’ve received your third Permanent Prestige Trait, the third set of prestige requirements remain in place for every subsequent Prestige.[/p][p]You can continue to Prestige almost indefinitely. [/p][p]Keep these Stash and Loadout basics in mind:[/p][list][*][p][b]Build your Loadout:[/b] Select weapons and items from your Stash to equip your Operator before deploying.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Store items and weapons:[/b] Remove any unwanted Loadout items and place them in the Stash. Kits:[/b] Obtained from the Survival Kit station in the FOB, containing bundles of equipment to use during deployments.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Fire Support:[/b] Access powerful Killstreak support rewards.[/p][/*][/list][p]The DMZ Level Unlocks provide a progression path that gradually unlocks and improves the mode’s core systems.[/p][p][/p][h3]Events[/h3][p][i]Available Immediately / Accessed within the FOB, or the left side blade menu.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fa6241fb6461fd6486b0bd9583550ceb5c1dc43e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Check this station when an Event is active in [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]. Challenges, or other unlocks are currently available, many of which may be only available for a limited time.[/p][p][/p][h3]Deploy[/h3][p][i]Available Immediately / Accessed via the Deploy menu or the Deploy area (razor wire and helicopter access).[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6fd4913643e4556cad0b9082d8d0732b186f8a92.jpg"][/img][/p][p]When you and your squad are ready to drop into Hajin, access the Deploy menu, and choose one of three deployment options:[/p][list][*][p][b]Story Missions:[/b] There is a power vacuum in Hajin. Follow orders, unmask the new threat, and destroy their operations across the DMZ.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Dynamic Operations:[/b] Deploy directly into a Dynamic Op to earn DMZ Cash and Experience. Every completed Operation provides a Supply Drop of increasing rarity for your squad.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Free Roam:[/b] Deploy without a mission and explore Hajin City.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Story Missions Deployment: Preparation.[/b][/p][p]Select “Story Missions” to access the following:[/p][list][*][p]A selection of missions you can complete or replay.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Intel and objectives via a mission briefing.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Mission Rewards (usually high value gear and DMZ Cash). [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The ability to choose a random Story Mission.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Additional rewards for specific completion milestones. Tip: Check your Story Mission with you and your squadmates’ current DMZ Orders, as they may have objectives you can complete simultaneously.[/p][/*][/list][p]Ready Up: Once your mission is chosen, you enter the Ready Up Menu.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][b]Dynamic Operations and Free Roam Deployment: Preparation.[/b][/p][p]Select “Dynamic Operations” or “Free Roam” to access your infil options (some requiring funds or progression to unlock):[/p][list][*][p][b]Ground (Free):[/b] The deployment begins in a random part of Hajin, with you and your squad on foot.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Polaris Dagor A1 (5,000 DMZ Cash):[/b] Your team appears in a random part of Hajin, with a lightly armored vehicle air-dropped into your location. The vehicle provides a rapid response.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]LTV (25,000 DMZ Cash):[/b] Your team appears in a random part of Hajin, with this heavily armored vehicle air-dropped into your location. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Helicopter (50,000 DMZ Cash):[/b] Your squad embarks from the FOB in a helicopter, before appearing over a random part of Hajin, with one of you piloting a helicopter and the others in passenger seats. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Cargo Plane (100,000 DMZ Cash):[/b] Your team drops from a large cargo plane. This allows you to pinpoint an exact location within Hajin to drop into and explore. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Selecting Free Roam[/b] is an excellent decision if you’re focusing on looting for 3D Printer Ingredients, hunting down Wanted Operators, and most importantly; it is excellent for working on completing your DMZ Orders.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Ready Up:[/b] Once your method of infil is chosen, you enter the Ready Up Menu. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/46d6fb33cbe7a5553f197bcf67219ba94158c6ea.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Deployment: Ready Up[/b][/p][p]The Ready Up Menu is the final time you can prepare for your deployment. Here you can:[/p][p][b]Equip Free Loadout:[/b] Although a set of basic gear might be helpful for those Operators without in-game funds or 3D Printer capabilities to fill out their Loadouts, the Free Loadout is an excellent way to get into a match quickly, and work towards building up your Stash reserves. Extract and you keep these Loadout items.[/p][p][b]Edit Loadout:[/b] Update your Backpack and Loadout items to include key items you missed packing. The following are recommended to add to an Infil Loadout:[/p][p]	A Plate Carrier (for armor)[/p][p]	A Backpack (for items)[/p][p]	A Weapon (for offense)[/p][p]	A Medkit (to repair wounds)[/p][p][b]Edit Active Duty:[/b] Swap in another Active Duty Operator for your deployment. [/p][p][b]Squad Fill and Cancel Deployment:[/b] You can elect to have “Squad Fill” on or off. [/p][p]Squad Fill automatically drops you into your deployment with two other allied players. This is recommended if you don’t have a squad of friends to deploy with.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/91fa01cf668c86608756b17158af939f05337322.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Your DMZ Deployment is Almost Here![/h3][p]With your newfound FOB knowledge, and a tactical overview of the theater of operators at your fingerprints courtesy of the Hajin: Tour of Duty Blog, you’re almost ready to deploy into war-torn Hajin. Remember; DMZ Early Access begins, starting October 20* for anyone who pre-orders a digital version of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]![/p]

newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/335762ec7cc40c8f1041504bc6a614edc6ad50d6.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Breaking News: Modern Warfare 4: DMZ Early Access Confirmed![/h2][p]This is Warfare Without Limits. Experience the gripping story of [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i], as well as DMZ, Call of Duty’s action extraction shooter, before the October 23 launch. Campaign and DMZ Early Access are confirmed. Here’s the intel:[/p][p][/p][h3]How Do I Access the Modern Warfare 4 Campaign and DMZ Early?[/h3][p]Starting on Friday, October 16, players who have digitally pre-ordered or pre-purchased [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/i] get Early Access to the game’s Campaign.[/p][p]Then, starting on Tuesday October 20, players who have digitally pre-ordered or pre-purchased [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/i] can gain Early Access to all of DMZ.*[/p][p]This benefit applies to those pre-ordering or pre-purchasing the Standard Digital Edition or Vault Edition of the game on Steam. [url="https://www.callofduty.com/blog/2026/05/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-preorder-benefits-game-editions-details#Vault"]See this blog for pre-order benefits[/url].[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="SV5vKAAkQkQ;full"][/previewyoutube][p][i]*Campaign and DMZ Early Access start dates differ. Actual play time subject to possible outages and applicable time zone differences. Actual platform availability and start dates subject to change.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2]WELCOME TO DMZ[/h2][p]This is Call of Duty’s [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1938090/view/680752246528410471"]definitive extraction shooter experience[/url], featuring persistent progression and open-world combat environment. You’re free to explore, engage AI forces and rival Operators, loot valuable items, craft gear, and complete objectives— all while keeping your eye on the final exfil, extracting with your rewards at the end of each deployment. How you approach each deployment, within a squad or acting alone, is entirely up to you.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/fbb2b156cfa462836f7fdda8d2f28f9e511eefe5.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You’re here to learn everything there is to know about [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i]’s DMZ. The intel has been separated into two blogs.[/p][p][b]Part 1: Tour of Duty – Hajin Environments and Threats, Full Intel Guide[/b] [/p][p]Think you’re ready to deploy into war-torn Hajin? Consult the Tour of Duty – Hajin blog for a full rundown of its points of interest, key buildings, vehicles, enemy threats, and trackable statistics. Click here to read this blog.[/p][p][b]Part 2: Tour of Duty – Forward Operating Base (FOB) Full Intel Guide[/b][/p][p]A tour of the FOB stations, with information on 3D Printer crafting, Bounties, Weapon acquisition, Stashes and Loadouts, Active Duty Operators, DMZ Operator Prestiging, Permanent Prestige Traits, and DMZ Player Progression to Level 70. You’re reading this now![/p][p]Welcome to the Forward Operating Base.[/p][p][/p][h3]Forward Operating Base (FOB): Overview[/h3][p][i]Available Immediately / Accessed from the DMZ Main Menu[/i] [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/1c554cf376a4e7e6281ad6415c55e5ef6e858acd.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The Forward Operating Base (FOB) is your home between DMZ deployments. This navigable encampment allows you to offload your loot, gear up, receive your next Orders, before you head back into Hajin. The FOB is also home to DMZ’s permanent progression, including customizing your Active Duty Operators.[/p][p]As you conduct further deployments into the Exclusion Zone, the FOB unlocks and upgrades into a fully established base.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/0204878e6d8824256b446cc2aa417bbb7795483b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Throughout the FOB, there are various stations, and they can be critical to your survival when deployed in the Exclusion Zone. Some stations are unlocked through playing DMZ and can then be upgraded using the 3D Printer station. These stations allow you to track down dangerous Lieutenants, build out your perfect weapon, swap out your Active Duty Operator, craft powerful gear, and more. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4b72782d83a01c3daded6d266ca46cad8e99e5fe.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Here are the Stations that your FOB is comprised of, starting with those you should access first:[/p][list][*][p][b]Operators (Active Duty):[/b] Manage your available Operators, check their status, upgrade their Traits, and select one ready for deployment.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]DMZ Orders:[/b] DMZ Orders are your guiding Mission Directives in DMZ. These assist with getting you onboarded, telling the story of DMZ and challenging you to master the exclusion zone.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Stash/Loadout:[/b] The Stash allows you to store a variety of loot types from Weapons to Gear to 3D Printer Ingredients and more! Every time you extract, make sure to offload items you'll need in future deployments. Equip weapons and gear in your Loadout, ready for the next infil.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Firing Range:[/b] Test your weapons (especially your optics) and sharpen your aim in this wooded grove, with targets positioned from close to more than 100 meters away.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Survival Kits:[/b] These are themed packs of loot items that can be opened and then used to gear up or used to craft.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Bounty Leaderboard:[/b] Track the most successful PvP bounty hunters and killers across the Exclusion Zone.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a4c0db9193266db39dfaa400898050446c6a5c9f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Continue your successful deployments across Hajin, and you’re soon able to expand your FOB, and unlock additional stations:[/p][list][*][p][b]3D Printer (Unlocks at DMZ Player Level 2):[/b] This uses a mix of Printer Resources and 3D Printer Ingredients to craft a variety of gear. The 3D Printer is also used to upgrade various stations in the FOB provided you have the required loot items.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Boss Board (Unlocks after you complete your second DMZ Order):[/b] Purchase intel on Lieutenants, then locate and prepare to hunt down Hajin’s most powerful adversaries. Additional information is also available for Commanders.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Vendor (Unlocks at DMZ Player Level 5):[/b] The Vendor has a variety of weapons and other items for sale using DMZ Cash. The vendor’s wares rotate day to day so get this gear while it’s available! [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Gunsmith (Unlocks at DMZ Player Level 10):[/b] Use in-game DMZ Cash to purchase attachments for looted weapons and to build brand new weapons from scratch. The attachments you can build are related to the level of the weapon and the shared attachments unlocked for that weapon. To increase the weapons you can build in Gunsmith you need to find and extract Weapon Manuals.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Dog Tag Case (Unlocks at DMZ Player Level 20):[/b] Display Dog Tags collected from defeated Operators and favorite the ones you don’t want to lose.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="DLGc9WYbIyE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The last stations are immediately available, and detail your full DMZ Player Progression, as well as confirming your deployment into Hajin:[/p][list][*][p][b]DMZ Progression:[/b] DMZ has its own dedicated Progression Track which awards key Printer Recipes, Unlocks FOB stations, and awards various other content all the way up to level 70![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Deploy:[/b] A threshold of razor wire leading to a heavy-lift military transport helicopter where you’ll begin each DMZ deployment.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Operators Station: Active Duty[/h3][p][i]Available Immediately / Accessed within the FOB, or the left side blade menu.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/c45dae9eac1f28399714527d3cf5dbe372c97adb.jpg"][/img][/p][p]The [b]Operators Station[/b] is where you can view, manage, and [b]select your Active Duty Operators[/b]. In DMZ, Operators are generally a cosmetic preference, individual characters who grow stronger as you survive deployments and award them Traits. You earn [b]DMZ Player Level XP[/b] with them.[/p][p]Each Operator comes with a set of Dog Tags. As an Active Duty Operator progresses, the quality of these Dog Tags improves, and Trait Points are awarded. Trait Points can be spent across three Trait Trees, allowing you to specialize in different playstyles. Ultimately, your Active Duty Operator can earn permanent Prestige Traits that are tied to each individual Operator.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/a02d84bc0928aae17d5becca963a8d8b253d2720.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Recruiting an Operator[/h3][p]Firstly, recruit an Operator to an open slot. The Operator you pick for a slot is locked to that slot until they are dismissed by you in favor of a replacement. [/p][list][*][p]Example: If you select Reece as an Operator, you cannot change to another Operator. You also cannot choose Reece again in another Active Duty slot.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Operator Skins: You can change Reece’s Operator Skin in this menu.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]You begin with two available Active Duty Operator slots and can unlock another slot by progressing your DMZ level.[/p][/*][/list][p]Players with the [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] Vault Edition have access to an additional Active Duty slot and start with three instead of two.[/p][p][/p][h3]Understanding the Active Duty Basics[/h3][p]Keep these Active Duty basics in mind:[/p][list][*][p][b]Manage multiple Operators:[/b] Maintain multiple Active Duty Operators, giving you different builds to choose from.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Earn Trait Points:[/b] Successfully earn DMZ XP with an Operator to upgrade their Dog Tags, receiving a Trait Point each time you level up your Dog Tags. Traits are used to improve that specific Operator in various ways.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Choose your Traits:[/b] Spend Trait Points across three different playstyle Trait Trees; Warfighter, Scout, and Survivalist.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Create specialized Operators:[/b] A single Operator can earn up to 18 Trait Points.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Use your Active Duty slots and Trait selections to build Operators around different playstyles.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/4d27b0dc96a97b0996492108731dad62be6d7abc.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]MIA Operators[/h3][p]If an Operator is eliminated during a deployment, they become MIA (Missing in Action) and cannot deploy again until they are recovered.[/p][list][*][p][b]Recover an MIA Operator:[/b] Spend DMZ Cash to bring an MIA Operator back while preserving all of their Traits. Access the Operators station and pay DMZ Cash from your in-game Bank to rescue them.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Progression and Cost:[/b] The cost to recover an Operator is determined by their Trait Points. The more Traits, the more expensive their return.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Reequip:[/b] Recovered Operators return without their gear, so equip a new Loadout before deploying again.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Dismiss and start over:[/b] Instead of recovery, you can dismiss an MIA Operator and start fresh with a new Operator.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Operator Dog Tag[/h3][p]Each Operator has a Dog Tag available to inspect in your Loadout, that represents the progression of the Operator wearing it. It can be removed if the Operator dies during a deployment and is recovered if an MIA Operator is brought back to Active Duty. The higher the quality (or Level) of the Dog Tag, the higher the progression of the Operator. This Dog Tag also shows the Bounty status of the Operator, and the enemy Operator kill count.[/p][p]As you progress and earn XP within DMZ, your Dog Tag’s Level progresses, allowing you to unlock Traits:[/p][p][b]Progression (18 Levels):[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Steel (I, II, III)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Bronze (I, II, III)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Silver (I, II, III)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Gold (I, II, III)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Damascus (I, II, III)[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Onyx (I, II, III)[/p][/*][/list][p]The Level of your Dog Tag is worth noting, as rival Operators can defeat you in combat, and loot your belongings, including your Dog Tag, to display in their Dog Tag Case (see later in this Blog).[/p][p]Earn XP to increase your Dog Tag Level, receiving a Trait Point every time you reach a new Dog Tag Level. This is the key to accessing Traits.[/p][p]An Operator’s level (indicated by their Dog Tag quality) and a player’s overall DMZ level are independent. An Operator is considered fully leveled up when the Onyx III is reached, and 18 Trait Points have been earned. At this point, you can Prestige the Operator (see below).[/p][p][/p][h3]The Three Trait Trees[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/16ad32f27557bc32ade50e4a7c7a140014d61511.jpg"][/img][/p][p]These are accessed from the quick navigation left-blade menu for your currently equipped Operator and is also accessible via the Operator menu. Any Trait Tree Points you earn after successfully earning a Dog Tag level up after an exfil as that Operator are accessible here. You can have multiple Operators active (as many as you have slots) with each individually earning Trait Points. Spend Trait Points to acquire Traits from one of three Trees:[/p][list][*][p]Warfighter[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Scout[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Survivalist[/p][/*][/list][p]There are 66 Traits available in DMZ, spread equally across the three Trees. Not all of them can be accessed by your Operator, as you can only have a maximum of 18 Trait Points before you fully level up your Operator and reach Onyx III Dog Tag status. Here’s how this works:[/p][list][*][p]Every successful exfil awards you DMZ XP, and the level of your Dog Tag is affected by this. Acquire enough and you level up your Dog Tag, earning one Trait Point each time. If you’ve done particularly well during a deployment, you may level up your Dog Tag more than once.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]When you’ve acquired your first Trait Point, study the three Trait Trees closely. Each Tree has a total of 22 different Traits you can access.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Each Trait Tree consists of the following:[/p][/*][*][p]Six Major Traits (always visible, arranged in groups of two aside from the initial Trait pick).[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]16 Minor Traits (randomized, including the random Trait that you obtain when you first unlock each tree. Minor Traits are only visible if you’ve unlocked the previous Main Trait below the Minor group and arranged in groups of three). [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Plan ahead to pick your preferred Main Trait, and then the available Minor Traits that complement your overall goals or playstyle along the way. Choose to unlock more Traits from an existing Trait Tree, or Traits from a different tree.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Spend your first Trait point on the initial (random) Minor Trait for that tree. The remaining Traits are in branches of two (Major) and three (Minor). [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Unlock one of the Traits from a previous branch to reach the next branch. Then choose a single Trait from that branch.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Continue until you’ve either completed unlocking a Tree (unlocking a maximum of nine Traits, one per branch) or unlocked a variety of branches from multiple Trees, as shown in the adjacent Trait menu screenshot.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Once you pick a Trait, it is locked in and can’t be substituted.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Therefore, with 18 Trait Points before you maximize your Operator level (and no more Trait Points are awarded), you can elect to max out two of the three Trait Trees or open all three to varying degrees of completion.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Remember: The more Traits you have, the more expensive your Operator is to rescue if they are downed during a deployment.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/20863df32fe99346cc6cc8892005973123ed3cc6.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Example Traits[/h3][p]There’s a great deal of variety of Traits to uncover as you progress your Operator, especially as these can (eventually) become permanently unlocked if you decide to Prestige in DMZ. Here are examples of the six Main (visible) Traits for each of the three Trait Trees, and one random Minor Trait that was awarded when our Operator first accessed each of the three Trait Trees:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Main Warfighter Traits[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Adrenaline Burst:[/b] Killing an enemy resets tactical sprint.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Equipment Professional:[/b] Slowly recharges equipped Lethals and Tacticals after use.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Combat Resistance:[/b] Reduces damage from explosives and the effects of enemy Tacticals.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Viper Sense:[/b] Conceals you from thermal optics and AI targeting systems.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Quick Fix:[/b] Reduces health regeneration delay when an enemy operator or hostile is killed.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Possum:[/b] Allows a Self Revive into Last Stand from death, restoring health to maximum, once per match.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Adaptive Restock:[/b] Enemy hostile drop one additional item.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Main Scout Traits[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Investor:[/b] Slightly increases cash amount extracted.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Hostile Looter:[/b] Enemy hostiles sometimes drop an Uncommon printer ingredient, with a very small chance for a Rare printer ingredient.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Container Looter:[/b] Chance to get extra piece of loot in containers.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Thermal Padding:[/b] Hides from UAVs and downgrades Advanced UAVs to UAV detection.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]UAV Upgrade:[/b] Increases the range and duration of UAVs. Also upgrades them to Advanced UAVs.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Overwatch:[/b] UAV towers you activate never expire.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Field Crafting:[/b] Allows crafting items directly out of Common printer resources while deployed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Main Survivalist Traits[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Air Superiority:[/b] Extends the duration of UAV towers and SAM sites.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Faster Revive:[/b] Increases Revive speeds.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Consumable Duration:[/b] Increases the duration of consumables.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Impact Smokes[/b]: Releases smoke when downed.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Free Revive:[/b] Automatically repairs your first Wound.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Numb the Pain:[/b] Applies Painkillers and Smelling Salts effects on revives.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Die Hard:[/b] Approaching an exfil while in Last Stand calls the exfil automatically. Also grants infinite bleed out time while in Last Stand.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Operators Station: DMZ Operator Prestige[/h3][p][i]Available after an Active Duty Operator earns 18 Trait Points / Accessed at the Operators station or Traits side menu[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dd4b3ba3e1af8f428d0a2b0e8c43a7bc5aefa6a8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Once an Active Duty Operator earns 18 Trait Points, you can Prestige the Operator as long as they aren’t MIA and require rescuing. DMZ Operator Prestige is separate from the standard Level 1–55 Player Progression, the 1-70 DMZ Player Progression and other MW4 Prestige systems. It is tied to a specific Operator.[/p][p]DMZ Operator Prestige is optional, the requirements to Prestige can be a challenge, but the reward is worth it: With each Operator Prestige, [b]a special random Prestige Trait[/b] [b]is equipped permanently to that Operator[/b]. Operators can earn up to three Prestige Traits.[/p][p]Here are the requirements for your Operator to Prestige for the first time:[/p][list][*][p][b]Requirement 1:[/b] Maximum Operator Level: You must have earned a total of 18 Trait Points with the Operator. The Trait Points don’t need to be spent, though it is recommended you do so.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Requirement 2:[/b] Equip Gear of Specific Rarity: Acquire and equip high Rarity Loadout equipment to the Operator’s Loadout and Backpack. newsitems.title: Valve ускорила перезарядку AUG в Counter-Strike 2 и исправила ошибки на картах Rush в свежем обновлении
newsitems.contents:
Valve выпустила небольшое обновление для Counter-Strike 2 от 9 октября. Патч затронул баланс оружия, звуковые эффекты и геометрию карт, а также принёс несколько технических исправлений. Размер загрузки составил около 539 МБ.

Главное изменение касается AUG: время перезарядки винтовки сократили на полсекунды. Такая корректировка может повлиять на поведение оружия в перестрелках, хотя сама по себе не означает масштабного пересмотра его баланса. Кроме того, разработчики добавили специальный значок для выброшенных наборов сапёра, чтобы их было проще заметить на карте.

Valve также исправила ошибку со звуковым событием при бесшумной перезарядке Desert Eagle. Ещё одно исправление касается просмотра демок: теперь не должны возникать гудящие фоновые звуки. Помимо этого, разработчики продолжили устранять проблемы с геометрией на картах режима Rush, обновили локализацию и внесли улучшения в стабильность игры.

Предыдущий небольшой патч для CS2 вышел 6 октября. Тогда Valve добавила кнопки управления загруженными картами из Мастерской, обновила локализованные элементы фотокниги питомцев и скорректировала параметры кэша шейдеров VK. Новое обновление продолжает серию точечных улучшений без крупных изменений игрового процесса.

newsitems.title: The Final Road to PGC begins: PGS Circuit 4!
newsitems.author: Eoin
newsitems.contents: [p]Hello, PUBG Esports fans![/p][p align="start"]The final stretch of the 2026 PUBG Global Series is approaching: [b]PGS Circuit 4[/b]. With PGS 10, PGS 11, and the Circuit Final, PGS 12, the three remaining tournaments will bring this year’s 12-event PUBG Global Series to a close.[/p][p align="start"]Circuit 4 is more than just the final circuit of the season. With the conclusion of PGS 12, the [b]final PGS Points standings for the 2026 season will be determined, deciding the eight teams that will advance to PUBG Global Championship 2026.[/b][/p][p align="start"]After three circuits of competition, the race for PGC is beginning to take shape—but nothing has been decided yet. With PGS 10, PGS 11, and double points on the line at PGS 12, there are still [b]240 PGS Points[/b] up for grabs.[/p][p align="start"]Which teams will earn their way to PGC 2026 through PGS Points? Let’s take a closer look at [b]Circuit 4, the final competition of the 2026 PGS season.[/b][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261007/QYvMFGPC.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]PGS Circuit 4 Schedule[/b][/h2][p align="start"]PGS Circuit 4 will take place from [b]October 14 to November 1[/b].[/p][list][*][p][b]PGS 10[/b][/p][list][*][p]Group Stage: October 14[/p][/*][*][p]Winners Stage: October 15[/p][/*][*][p]Survival Stage: October 16[/p][/*][*][p]Final Stage: October 17–18[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]PGS 11[/b][/p][list][*][p]Winners Stage: October 22[/p][/*][*][p]Survival Stage: October 23[/p][/*][*][p]Final Stage: October 24–25[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]PGS 12[/b][/p][list][*][p]Survival Stage: October 29[/p][/*][*][p]Grand Finals: October 30–November 1[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"]As the [b]Circuit Final[/b], PGS 12 will see the top eight teams in the Circuit 4 PGS Points standings advance directly to the Grand Finals based on the points accumulated through PGS 10 and PGS 11. The remaining 16 teams will compete in the Survival Stage for the remaining spots in the Grand Finals.[/p][p align="start"]When PGS 12 comes to an end, it will mark not only the conclusion of Circuit 4, but also the end of the [b]2026 season-long PGS Points race spanning PGS 1 through PGS 12.[/b][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261007/dfU4pJIb.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h2][b]PGS Points Standings[/b][/h2][p align="start"]With three circuits and nine PGS events now complete, the battle for PGS Points is more intense than ever.[/p][p align="start"]At the conclusion of Circuit 3, [b]Virtus.pro leads the standings with 261 points[/b], followed by Made in Thailand with 224 points, 17Gaming with 223 points, and T1 with 208 points.[/p][p align="start"]Currently occupying the final PGC qualification spot is [b]Petrichor Road in eighth place with 152 points.[/b][/p][p align="start"]But the gaps around the cutoff remain narrow. Seventh-place Falcons sit just two points ahead at 154, while ninth-place Gen.G Esports trail the current PGC qualification line by only seven points with 145.[/p][p align="start"]Most importantly, [b]Circuit 4 is still to come.[/b] The current standings are far from the final picture of who will advance to PGC.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"] [img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261007/WQDtO1dg.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]PGC 2026 Qualification & PGS Points[/b][/h2][p align="start"]The [b]top eight teams in the final PGS Points standings[/b], accumulated across PGS 1 through PGS 12 during the 2026 season, will qualify for PGC 2026.[/p][p align="start"]And the final standings determine more than just qualification. The higher a team finishes in the PGS Points standings, the [b]later the stage from which they will begin their PGC 2026 journey.[/b][/p][p align="start"]The team finishing [b]1st in PGS Points will advance directly to the PGC 2026 Grand Finals[/b]. The [b]2nd-place team will enter at Survival Stage Day 1[/b], while the teams finishing [b]3rd through 8th will begin their journey in the Qualifying Stage[/b].[/p][p align="start"]This means Circuit 4 is about more than simply breaking into the Top 8. For teams already inside the qualification zone, the battle will continue until the very end as they fight for a higher PGS Points ranking and a more advantageous PGC seed.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"][b]240 PGS Points Are Still Up for Grabs[/b][/p][p align="start"]In both [b]PGS 10 and PGS 11[/b], the winner will earn [b]60 PGS Points[/b], with points awarded down through 16th place.[/p][p align="start"]At the Circuit Final, [b]PGS 12, the points will be doubled[/b]. The winner will earn 120 points, with 96 points going to second place, and double the PGS 10 and PGS 11 point values applied throughout the standings.[/p][p align="start"]That means the maximum number of points a single team can earn in Circuit 4 is:[/p][p align="start"][b]60 points (PGS 10 1st) + 60 points (PGS 11 1st) + 120 points (PGS 12 1st) = 240 points.[/b][/p][p align="start"]Considering the current gaps both inside and outside the PGC qualification zone, the three remaining tournaments leave plenty of room for the final standings to change.[/p][p align="start"]For teams outside the Top 8, Circuit 4 represents one final opportunity to make their move. For those already inside, it will be the final test to defend their position and secure a higher PGC seed.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"][img src="https://wstatic-prod-boc.krafton.com/common/news/20261007/flRoBb1G.png" style="border-style: none; max-width: 100%; position: relative; display: block; float: none; margin: 5px auto; vertical-align: top;"][/img][/p][h2][b]PGS 10 Groups[/b][/h2][p align="start"]And it all begins with [b]PGS 10[/b].[/p][p align="start"]The Group Stage groups have been confirmed for the 24 teams competing in PGS 10. The teams have been divided into Groups A, B, and C through a [b]snake seeding format based on the final results of PGS 9.[/b][/p][p align="start"]PGS 9 winner Gen.G Esports has been placed in Group A, second-place T1 in Group B, and third-place Falcons in Group C. From there, the direction of placement alternates according to the PGS 9 standings, distributing all 24 teams across the three groups.[/p][list][*][p][b]Group A:[/b] Gen.G Esports, Made in Thailand, Virtus.pro, TEAM LIQUID, DN SOOPers, Sharper Esports, Team Vitality, Natus Vincere[/p][/*][*][p][b]Group B:[/b] T1, Alpha Gaming, GAM The Expendables, eArena, Petrichor Road, FULL SENSE, TYLOO, JD Gaming[/p][/*][*][p][b]Group C:[/b] Falcons, Geekay Esports, Anyone’s Legend, 17Gaming, FOUR ANGRY MEN, Twisted Minds, 09(Team Nemesis at PGS 9), Godlike[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"] [i]※ Further updates will be provided if there are any changes to the tournament.[/i][/p][p][/p][h2][b]The Final Step to PGC[/b][/h2][p align="start"]The 2026 PUBG Global Series journey that began with PGS 1 now has just three tournaments remaining.[/p][p align="start"]There is still everything to play for after Circuit 3. With 60 points available at each of PGS 10 and PGS 11, followed by 120 points at PGS 12, [b]a total of 240 points remain on the table—and a single strong finish could reshape the race to PGC.[/b][/p][p align="start"]Which teams will finish inside the final Top 8 and earn their place at PGC 2026? And which team will rise to the very top of the standings to secure a direct seed to the [b]PGC Grand Finals[/b]?[/p][p align="start"]The final competition of the [b]2026 PUBG Global Series[/b] is about to begin.[/p][p align="start"][b]Tune in and cheer on your favorite teams as they make their final push toward PGC 2026![/b][/p]

newsitems.title: Игрок в Counter-Strike 2 написал магистерскую диссертацию о том, как выследить и навсегда избавиться от читера
newsitems.contents:
Простой студент и заядлый игрок в Counter-Strike 2 под ником magga_ защитил целую магистерскую диссертацию в Норвежском университете естественных и технических наук, предложив новый подход к борьбе с нечестными пользователями. Его работа посвящена системе поведенческой биометрии, которая позволяет вычислять реальную личность игрока по микромоторике рук и связывать баны с человеком, а не с его учетной записью Steam.

Главной уязвимостью современных античитов геймер назвал блокировку конкретных аккаунтов. Получив бан, реальный нарушитель просто покупает или регистрирует новый аккаунт и возвращается на серверы со своими читами. Разработанный алгоритм анализирует обычные записи матчей, которые игра уже сохраняет, и формирует персональный «цифровой отпечаток» на основе индивидуальных привычек ввода:

В соревновательном шутере игроки тысячи раз повторяют одни и те же действия под давлением фактора времени: флики, контр-стрейфы, контроль отдачи и броски гранат. Со временем эти движения переходят на уровень подсознательной мышечной памяти. Вы можете сменить ник, звание, аккаунт, оружие и даже общий стиль игры. Но изменить собственные руки куда сложнее.

— объяснил автор диссертации.

В ходе испытаний на выборке из более чем тысячи игроков система показала свою эффективность:

анализ движений мыши безошибочно определил пользователя во всех 100% случаев;

паттерны нажатий клавиатуры показали точность в 98%;

комбинация двух метрик безошибочно подтвердила все 13 известных исследователю тестовых пар аккаунтов одного и того же человека.

Что еще более интересно, в процессе тестирования система попутно разоблачила скрытых смурфов: несколько совпадений, которые автор сперва посчитал ложным срабатыванием, но при детальной проверке оказались дополнительными твинками игроков из базы данных. По замыслу создателя, данная технология могла бы работать в связке с VAC и системой «Фактора доверия». Это позволило бы античиту распознавать заблокированного игрока сразу же, как только тот садится за новую учетную запись.

Впрочем, исследователь признал и текущие ограничения проекта: метод пока не проходил испытания на миллионной аудитории серверов Valve, а также может давать сбои, если за одним компьютером поочередно играют несколько членов семьи. По этой причине автор рекомендует на первых порах использовать биометрический отпечаток как весомую улику для системы патруля, а не как повод для мгновенного бана. Разработчик надеется, что представители Valve или соревновательных платформ вроде FACEIT обратят внимание на исследование и помогут протестировать технологию в реальных условиях.

newsitems.title: Inside the Trove of Terror
newsitems.author: eugenep
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/44e04da47da8b634dee235756e4ffa1234879b40.png"][/img][/p][p]Some time ago, a time now none of us can quite recall, we began to set our minds on matters of the monstrous. Our work has always concerned itself with the manufacture of frightening things, so there was no reason at that time for alarm.[/p][p]Until we began to fill a new treasure chest with item sets themed around eldritch and otherworldly designs.[/p][p]As each horrific creation took more defined shape, unsettling yet tantalizing inspirations took hold of us. Fantastical and Immortal glamours coalesced around each and every set; they grew more spellbinding, a vision that would remain, stuck fast in the mind's eye. Thoughts of monsters birthed thoughts of even more monstrous monsters. Our minds became gateways for greater abominations still, our hands became not our own.[/p][p]Soon our collection of new item sets numbered fifteen, eldritch abominations from the realm of nightmare all. We knew each thing was hideous. Not one of us could look away. Not one of us was content to stop there.[/p][p]To master horrors, we required greater horrors... We required ARCANA.[/p][p]Our first attempt summoned the haunting shape of a Drow Ranger Arcana long thought lost to the flow of time. By some trick of the mind, she can look as she once did or assume a grave-stalking new form.[/p][p]Our appetites remained unsatisfied.[/p][p]Our second attempt unleashed something none of us had ever seen, something that hungrily emerged from a bloodstained sea: the all-new Maw of the Megalodon Arcana for the creature called Tidehunter, arriving with a new model, a host of custom animations, effects, taunts, voice lines, and dragging a familiar-looking corpse that serves as one part security blanket and one part snack. A whisper in the darkness, instructing, teasing: "Should one master this Arcana's secrets, one would surely unlock all three of its shark-toothed designs."[/p][p]This Trove is a doorway to things we cannot explain, let alone understand. The more of these treasures that you open, the more your own minds shine out like beacons to things lurking beyond the limits of reason. Open enough treasures and you're guaranteed to attract the gaze of an all-seeing new Tormentor. Open a number more and you'll surely summon the face of eldritch terror itself, manifesting as an incomprehensible new design for Roshan.[/p][p]We must part now with one final revelation. Take it as a warning if you wish. We didn't make this treasure... It made itself. We thought we were creating something, but we were not. We were merely the conduit, unknowingly letting something into our world from the great dark beyond: The Trove of Terror — overflowing with a mind-bending number of Immortal item sets, one new and one returning Arcana, and brand-new Tormentor and Roshan appearances — available now.[/p][p]If you dare, all you need to do is launch Dota to learn more.[/p]

[list]

[*]Fixed the Bone Chiller not hiding the correct bodygroup

[*]Updated the Bounty Hunter's Brim to fix a problem with the materials
[*]Updated the Clowning Cowl[list]
