newsitems.title: Player Trust & Positive Play: September 2026 Progress Report
newsitems.author: COD Official
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/39b665c07ea20af0dd35c23daf1ec096e839fe71.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Following Season 5, this update shares our latest progress reducing disruptive voice behavior across [i]Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone,[/i] along with ongoing work to support positive multiplayer experiences players already create in matches.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7a5aaa247adc0777abcf7283efcfcb5451fa1cab.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Continued Progress Reducing Disruptive Behavior[/h3][p][/p][p]Reducing disruptive interactions is a priority for [i]Call of Duty[/i]. We continue improving the systems that help identify, review, and act on Code of Conduct violations so players encounter fewer disruptive interactions in their matches.[/p][p]In the first 6 months after Black Ops 7’s release, continued investments in proactive moderation and system improvements helped drive lower disruptive voice behavior in [i]Black Ops 7[/i] and [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] compared with similar [i]Black Ops 6[/i] and [i]Warzone[/i] windows:[/p][list][*][p]~40% reduction in players exposed to harmful voice interactions.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]~50% reduction in disruptive voice offenders.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]~16% reduction in repeat voice offenders.[/p][/*][/list][p]These results reflect ongoing work across [i]Call of Duty[/i] teams to detect disruptive behavior earlier, improve moderation efficiency and effectiveness, and reduce disruptive voice interactions players encounter in matches. Harmful behavior can make it harder to coordinate with teammates and reducing those encounters helps more players spend more time playing instead of dealing with disruptive interactions.[/p][p]Our work also includes research collaborations that help us better understand how disruptive interactions appears during live matches and where we can continue improving.  One example is our recently published collaboration with Caltech, which explored player behavior at scale and to help inform future improvements. You can read more about this work at [url="research.activision.com"]research.activision.com[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]This work is ongoing. As disruptive behavior continues to evolve, our team will continue refining our systems, reviewing enforcement outcomes, and improving how we respond. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/dcfda1c393d54a760474a9157390abf320032f2a.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Positive Play: Supporting Better Teammate Moments[/h3][p]Reducing disruptive behavior remains one part of supporting a healthy multiplayer experience for the Call of Duty community. We do this through proactive detection, player reporting, enforcement, and ongoing improvements to our moderation systems. Positive Play is not about changing what makes Call of Duty competitive. It complements that work by understanding the moments that help players work better together, stay connected with their squad, and feel like they had a better match experience.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What do we mean by Positive Play?[/b][/p][p]One way we study Positive Play is through prosocial behavior, which we define as actions or interactions that benefit other players or the community.[/p][p][/p][p]That includes moments like:[/p][list][*][p]Supporting teammates through communication[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Reviving or buying back a teammate[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Thanking a teammate after a revive or buyback[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Sharing resources or loot[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Using voice or text chat to call out enemy positions or Points of Interest (POI) [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Using voice or text chat to call out harmful interactions[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]These interactions are already a regular part of the multiplayer experience. A recent case study examining prosocial voice interactions in Call of Duty: Warzone found:[/p][list][*][p]~ 22% of players encountered at least one supportive voice interaction.[/p][/*][*][p]~ 6% of players initiated at least one supportive voice interaction. Because these interactions often involve multiple teammates, a single positive moment can reach many players during the same match. [/p][/*][*][p]~66% of matches containing prosocial voice interactions also included at least one cooperative action, such as reviving or thanking another player.[/p][/*][/list][p]The findings suggest that supportive communication often occurs alongside cooperative gameplay.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve also observed early signals in select [i]Call of Duty: Warzone[/i] modes that suggest certain positive teammate interactions are associated with players choosing to continue playing together in after a match. Recent analysis in select Call of Duty: Warzone modes found that receiving a thanks from a random teammate was associated with players continuing to play together in the next match.[/p][p]The takeaway is that positive communication often shows up in the same moments where teamwork matters most. Supporting these positive interactions complements our work to reduce disruptive behavior while both contributing to a better multiplayer experience for players. These learnings help us better understand which moments matter to players and how future experiences could make positive play easier to recognize, more visible, more connected to the way players already work together in matches, and more rewarding to players.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/006808bd275cbe801373d6c6325baf6b77cdad81.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Looking Ahead[/h3][p]Helping improve the multiplayer experience requires both reducing disruptive behavior and supporting positive player interactions. Behind the scenes, this work reflects a long-running effort of our teams continuing to invest in proactive detection, moderation and enforcement, measurement, and ongoing system improvements, alongside academic research, and industry collaboration across Player Trust & Positive Play. We will continue improving our moderation systems, evaluating positive player interactions, and using data-informed insights to guide future investments to build a stronger understanding of how player behavior shapes multiplayer games. [/p][p] [/p][p]We’ll continue sharing our progress as our work evolves. Our commitment remains the same: creating a Call of Duty experience that’s competitive, fair, and fun for all.[/p][p] [/p]

newsitems.title: Modern Warfare 4 PC Trailer, Tech Updates, and More
newsitems.author: COD Official
newsitems.contents:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/8fb9728a184db1cec6037e2321fe155c9f280692.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Prepare for the release of [i]Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4[/i] on PC arriving October 23 on Steam. In close partnership with Infinity Ward, [i]Call of Duty[/i] PC lead developer Beenox is working on delivering the best experience possible across a wide variety of setups. [/p][p]Take a look at what’s coming in the official [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] PC trailer:[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="zuzBlGUDxx4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]PC Hardware: Designed for Many Specs[/h2][p]The Beenox and Infinity Ward teams have been working hard to ensure that Modern Warfare 4 performs well on a variety of PC system specs. Though the game looks great on high-end graphics cards, it isn’t just designed for players with the best GPUs. With 800+ customization options across graphics, gameplay, input devices, interface, and more, you can dial into the exact settings that work best for your setup.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/516e48a3700faf1ba14f96531c62a515d066f144.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Some of the major PC features we’re supporting include:[/p][list][*][p]Optimized Hardware Support: [i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] runs on most hardware while also seamlessly scaling up to crisp graphics and ultra-smooth, high FPS gameplay on higher-end setups. The game automatically configures settings based on your hardware.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Display Optimization: From 4K to 1440p to 1080p, from standard to Ultrawide, expect support for displays of all shapes and sizes.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Cutting-Edge Upscaling: Choose from a range of upscaling and frame generation technologies including AMD FSR Redstone, NVIDIA DLSS 4.5, Intel XeSS 3, and Filmic SMAA T2X.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]RICOCHET Anti-Cheat: A Multi-layered Anti-Cheat system combines server-side detections, hardware-based protections such as TPM 2.0 and Secure Boot integration, deep investigations, and legal action to combat the cheating market and keep gameplay fair. In addition to RICOCHET Anti-Cheat, expect account security with 2FA and email verification.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Sub-frame mouse polling: Increased mouse precision for aiming, in addition to support for a variety of input devices.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Visibility and Target Acquisition[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/38bb884d237e6d123791eb865fc0b8f269767c13.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Led by Infinity Ward in partnership with Beenox, significant progress has been made on improving visibility and clarity to the game across all platforms including PC, with the following updates:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Enhanced FOV[/b][/p][p]Available exclusively on PC, Enhanced FOV uses physically accurate lens effects to increase the field of view near the edges of your monitor without affecting the center FOV, a useful feature for players who prefer a smaller FOV but still want the awareness advantage of a wider field of view.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Greater Player Visibility[/b][/p][p]With HDR10+, the game engine interacts with your screen’s brightness settings in real time, adjusting contrast and lightning as needed for optimal clarity without the need to adjust manual sliders.

Additionally, expect new visual settings and setting values that lead to a sharper gameplay experience including:[/p][list][*][p]New sharpness slider global to any upscaler[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]New shading quality[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]New Filmic SMAA T2X settings[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Improved GFX settings such as:[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Screen Space Reflections [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Shadow Filtering Quality [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Occlusion and Screen Space Lighting [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Visual Clarity in Combat: Weapon VFX Masking[/b][/p][p]Muzzle effects are dynamically masked at the point of aim, keeping targets visible without reducing visual intensity.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Depth of Field[/b][/p][p]The Depth of Field setting will now be split between two settings: World Depth of Field and Weapon Depth of Field. With this change, players who prefer a sharper world can still experience the realistic effects of aiming with a weapon.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Weapon Bloom[/b][/p][p]In previous games, bullets fired used to hit randomly within a certain area of effect. In Modern Warfare 4, bullets are now fired based on the weapon’s barrel position, leading to more intuitive, precise, and realistic aiming, in both ADS and hipfire stances. Optionally add a Laser Attachment to your weapons to help you read where these shots are traveling.[/p][p][/p][h3]Performance and Settings[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/7dd7e6a3c4d78b01e632520cd595d14750a9ad3b.jpg"][/img][i]Modern Warfare 4[/i] is raising the bar for PC performance, targeting 90 FPS at Recommended Specs without compromising visual quality. Players can enjoy a smoother, more responsive gameplay experience, while the broad range of supported hardware keeps the game accessible to players with more modest setups.  [/p][list][*][p][b]90 FPS at Recommended Specs:[/b] Enjoy buttery smooth gameplay with 90 FPS support at Recommended Specs without manual setting tweaks to achieve this.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ray Tracing in All Modes:[/b] Ray Tracing is supported in Campaign, Multiplayer, and DMZ, enhancing graphical immersion with hyper-realistic reflections, shadows, and lighting. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Resolution Scaling Technique:[/b] Choose from several upscaling solutions based on your graphics card to maximize performance with the following options: [/p][/*][*][p][b]NVIDIA DLSS 4.5:[/b] NVIDIA RTX technology which uses a deep learning neural network to boost frame rates and generate beautiful, sharp images. [/p][/*][*][p][b]AMD FSR Redstone:[/b] Cutting edge upscaling technique developed from the ground up to produce high resolution frames from lower resolution inputs. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Intel XeSS 3:[/b] Super Sampling technology using machine learning to deliver more performance with expectational image quality. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Filmic SMAA T2X:[/b] Default post process effect to reduce perceived jagged edges in the final rendered image.[/p][/*][/list][p]

[b]Benchmark Tool[/b]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/2e723455a7f60d9b415627b15132f70adaa5c7a4.jpg"][/img]Zero in on performance stats with the built-in Benchmark Tool, which will run a simulated multiplayer sequence that tests your system’s, displaying real-time information including Average FPS, CPU, GPU, Ping, and Input Latency. Get a more detailed overview following the sequence with a breakdown on stats across all zones and in each individual zone, including setting suggestions to improve your system’s performance in different gameplay scenarios.

[/p][h3]Faster Time to Play[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42501705/6fd3b187b1bfb50715695d141d9b5aef919bc168.jpg"][/img]Spend less time waiting and more time playing with features that get you into the game faster, including:

[b]Advanced Shader Delivery[/b]

Get straight to playing with Advanced Shader Delivery (ASD), enabling MW4 to launch faster by delivering precompiled shaders ahead of time across supported PC platforms. A few minutes of preparation before launch day will mean less time managing downloads, updates, and setting up. newsitems.title: Джейсон Шрайер раскрыл подробности отменённого проекта Bungie - песочницы во вселенной Destiny под названием Payback
newsitems.contents:
Согласно отчёту Bloomberg, Bungie в течение некоторого времени работала над игрой-песочницей во вселенной Destiny. Проект, возглавляемый Люком Смитом и Марком Ноузворти, получил название Payback. По описанию Шрайера, это должен был быть «будущий» Destiny — с той же вселенной, но, возможно, без привычного названия франшизы.

Структура игры значительно отличалась от того, к чему привыкли фанаты Destiny. Шрайер сравнил Payback с Genshin Impact: акцент на героях, открытый мир, исследование и решение головоломок. Игровой процесс строился вокруг этих элементов, а не вокруг привычных шутерных механик.

Одна из ключевых идей Payback — привлечь более молодую аудиторию, которая ещё не была знакома с Destiny. Средний возраст игроков франшизы постоянно рос, а Destiny 2 плохо справлялась с привлечением новичков из-за сложной системы адаптации и удаления контента.

«В Payback было много отличий, но одна из идей заключалась в том, чтобы привлечь более молодую аудиторию, новую аудиторию, ту, которая ещё не была в самом центре вселенной Destiny, потому что средний возраст игроков Destiny постоянно увеличивался».

Payback был отменён летом 2024 года. Официальные причины не называются, но решение совпало с общей перестройкой стратегии Bungie и сложностями внутри студии.

Несмотря на отмену Payback, Bungie недавно подтвердила, что «не собирается заканчивать с Destiny». Студия анонсировала возвращение удалённого контента Destiny 2, включая кампании Red War и Forsaken.

«Мы понимаем, что удаление этих элементов оказало долгосрочное влияние на доверие игроков к Destiny и их удовольствие от игры. Destiny 2 — это больше, чем просто контент. Это место, где игроки вместе создавали воспоминания, заводили прочные дружеские отношения и делились опытом, который оставался с ними на протяжении многих лет. Мы не можем изменить принятое нами решение, но мы можем признать его последствия и приложить усилия, чтобы исправить ситуацию, восстановив эти важные части истории Destiny».

Однако студия предупредила, что возвращение контента займёт время: движок Destiny 2 сильно изменился после выхода Beyond Light, и старые зоны потребуют серьёзной адаптации — освещения, сражений, противников и игровых систем — под современные стандарты.

Параллельно Bungie продолжает работу над Marathon — PvPvE-шутером с элементами эвакуации. Следующее крупное обновление выйдет в декабре и добавит режим командного боя насмерть, социальное пространство и отдельный PvE-режим. Студия обещает «более глубокий опыт выживания», который выйдет «за рамки жанровых ограничений».

Таким образом, даже после отмены Payback Bungie сохраняет амбиции в отношении Destiny и продолжает экспериментировать с новыми форматами.

newsitems.title: В Destiny 2 вернется вырезанный контент, но Bungie не планирует возвращаться к регулярным обновлениям
newsitems.contents:
Bungie собирается вернуть в Destiny 2 значительный объём ранее отключённого контента, однако это не означает полноценного возвращения игры к прежней модели поддержки. Согласно отчёту Forbes, команда не планирует возобновлять регулярный выпуск крупных обновлений и нового контента.

Речь идёт о кампаниях, рейдах и миссиях, которые ранее были удалены в рамках системы vaulting. После запланированного возвращения они станут бесплатно доступны всем игрокам, в том числе тем, кто не владел ими до отключения. Таким образом, Bungie намерена существенно расширить доступный контент без необходимости покупать старые дополнения.

При этом, судя по информации Forbes, возвращение Destiny 2 связано именно с восстановлением уже существующего содержимого, а не с запуском нового цикла активной разработки. Поддержка игры, вероятно, продолжится на уровне, необходимом для работы восстановленных кампаний, рейдов и миссий, но крупных новых обновлений ожидать не стоит.

Сезонные события также не планируется возвращать в прежнем формате. Оружие и другие награды, которые игроки могли получать во время таких активностей, должны стать доступными через систему разблокировки контента. При этом часть побочных заданий, связанных с сезонными элементами, может не вернуться.

На этом фоне изменение стратегии Bungie выглядит скорее попыткой сохранить Destiny 2 как доступную библиотеку уже созданного контента, чем полноценным возобновлением её активного развития. При этом Destiny 3, согласно имеющейся информации, сейчас не находится в разработке, поэтому дальнейшие планы студии относительно будущего серии остаются неопределёнными.

newsitems.title: Bungie decide their destiny is to do more Destiny after all, pledging to bring back vaulted Destiny 2 campaigns while declaring that Marathon "needs to evolve"
newsitems.contents:
Not long after announcing changes to how they'll handle majorly updating Marathon going forwards, Bungie have reversed course on their decision to stop developing Destiny 2 - a move they followed with layoffs. Promising to bring back vaulted bits of Destiny 2 and declaring that the series is "foundational" to their future. A future which they've kicked off with a lot of grovelling for forgiveness.

newsitems.title: The International 2026 Grand Champions
newsitems.author: krAnk0r
newsitems.contents: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_LOC_IMAGE}/3703047/bab4343d906943ef2117ae553347d8f8991ebca3.png"][/img]Congratulations to Team Spirit, Grand Champions at The International 2026. After enduring a challenging year, Team Spirit regained their ultimate form just in time to take a five-game Grand Finals slugfest and claim the Aegis of Champions in Shanghai.[/p][p]Spirit's Group Stage started strong, with 2-0 victories over both Xtreme Gaming and Aurora Gaming. They followed with 2-1 win over Team Liquid that put Spirit just one series win away from qualifying for the main stage. They wouldn't get it. Instead, they served as a stepping stone. First to Team Vision, who dropped Spirit in just two games to secure their own invite to the arena. Next, Nigma Galaxy followed suit, handing Spirit another 0-2 loss to snatch a spot on the main stage and force Spirit into elimination play.[/p][p]Their elimination-round opponent? A scrappy Team Resilience who, despite their lower spot in the standings, had clawed out at least one victory in every series they'd played. This round would be no different. Team Spirit took game one with ease, but Resilience rebounded to force a win-or-go-home game three. There, Team Resilience managed to keep pace for a while, until Spirit pulled away in the back half of the match to secure their spot at The International Main Event.[/p][p]The first obstacle at the arena would be the dangerous Iron Wing -- who'd already taken Group Stage series wins off three teams who'd reached the main stage. It wouldn't matter. Team Spirit clipped Iron Wing to send them spiraling into the Lower Bracket and eventual elimination.[/p][p]The next series wouldn't net Spirit the same results. Team Vision, the foe that had already denied them an easy path to the Playoffs, was waiting for them once more. And the result was mostly the same -- Spirit lost. This time 1-2. This time falling into the Lower Bracket, where Team Liquid was already waiting after eliminating last year's champions. Liquid had a stellar showing in the groups, dropping only one series. But that loss came to this same Team Spirit squad they were again facing, and now Team Spirit wouldn't concede even one game.[/p][p]Spirit flushed Liquid out of the tournament to begin an undefeated run through the Lower Bracket, next bouncing both BoomBoys and Team Yandex with 2-0 statements to reach the Grand Finals against -- who else -- Team Vision, the front-runners that had been blocking Spirit's path every step of the way. The team that had stopped Spirit from skipping the elimination round. That had dropped them into the Lower Bracket to fight for their lives. The team that hadn't lost a single series in Shanghai... was now the one thing standing between Team Spirit and the Aegis of Champions.[/p][p]Game one was Team Spirit all the way. They looked to be cruising to victory in game two as well, but Vision had other plans, clawing back to even the series at one game apiece. It seemed that Vision might steal the momentum by snatching game three, but Spirit held firm to retake the series lead 2-1, just one win away from the Aegis. Once again, Vision would deny them. Their steady play in game four left no room for doubt -- this series was bound for a winner-take-all game five. And it didn't disappoint.[/p][p]After an hour-long showdown that was still anyone's game until the very end, Team Spirit finally overcame the team that had tormented them throughout the tournament, claiming the Aegis of Champions and crowning themselves the very best Dota team in the world. Three-time winners Yatoro and Collapse, and two-time winner Larl now welcome their teammates not_me and rue into an immortal pantheon.[/p][p]As bearers of the ultimate symbol of victory, these names shall forever be inscribed upon the Aegis of Champions:[/p][p][/p][p][b]2026 - Team Spirit[/b][/p][list][*][p]Illia "Yatoro" Muliarchuk[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Denis "Larl" Sigitov[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Magomed "Collapse" Khalilov[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Alexey "not_me" Kosmynin[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Alexander "rue" Filin[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/55481652342_4378ab4bed_6k.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Until Next Time[/h3][p]If you missed any of the broadcast, or just want to rewatch some of the iconic plays, head over to the [url="https://www.youtube.com/user/dota2"]Dota 2 YouTube channel[/url], where you'll find replays of the entire show. You can also find a collection of photos from the event over on the [url="https://www.instagram.com/dota2/"]Dota 2 Instagram[/url] and even more hi-res shots on our [url="https://www.flickr.com/photos/dota2ti/"]Dota 2 flickr[/url].  As always, we'd like to thank all of the players, talent, and everyone in the Dota community for helping bring this global celebration to life. We've been honored to once again help shepherd this event to the stage, but it wouldn't be what it is without all of you.[/p]
